correctness.rationale: For unitary U, each row and column has norm one and the cross-update residual squared Frobenius norm is exactly n-2+1/|U_ij|^2. The strict event is an entry-magnitude threshold δ; row normalization forces at most n(n-1) qualifying pivots, giving probability <(n-1)δ. The explicit unitary I+(exp(iθ)-1)11*/n realizes n(n-1) offdiagonal pivots with squared amplitude (1-η)δ for any η>0 in the stated threshold regime, yielding the exact supremum. The limit t^2T→(n-1)/n follows algebraically. The verified standalone program passed 34,902 deterministic checks, not used to certify infinite cases.
